reconciliations.name: Supplier balances
reconciliations.status: €45,000 opening payable plus €459,000 purchases less €378,000 cash paid equals €126,000 closing payables.

uncertainties: €9,000 difference between inventory cost roll-forward and saleable physical-count values.
Opening supplier payable of €45,000 is inferred from the supplier roll-forward and requires remittance confirmation.
No insurance policy, payment, prepayment, or consumption evidence was supplied.
Legal claim range is €20,000–€30,000; €25,000 is the best estimate.
€2,000 disposal quote is disclosed but not recorded as a present obligation.

boardRecommendation.summary: Use the corrected provisional accounts, not management’s €312,000 claimed profit, for valuation decisions.
actions: Move September deposits to contract liabilities.
Reconcile supplier remittances and inventory variance.
Tighten credit controls and pursue the R-17 balance.
